RS-1.where: The plate captions under S55 (entry 14.68) and S63 (entry 14.89)
RS-1.what_and_fix: The fix pass changed both specs' reader_question, but the caption under each plate still prints the plan's first question, because phase3_ch14_build.py takes the plan row's reader_question when the entry has no caption. S55 prints "Do rents run higher where renters earn more, with each state sized by its renter households?" over a chart now about the four largest renter states; S63 prints "Where do the fights over removals, spending and watchdogs stand?", where the data lead's RF-15 asked for "disputes". Update the two plan rows to the specs' questions, or have the generator take the spec's reader_question first.
RS-1.owner: Main session (the plan's two rows) or engineer (phase3_ch14_build.py)

judgments.red_share: A-M2 and B-S4 landed under D3-890 and the data lead’s RF-1: S47 and S53 now export with no Pillar Red, and the kit fails any export past 5 percent. The drawings read better for it: S47 is a light field with one dark tile, and S53’s dark band reads at once in grayscale.
judgments.s58_band: B-M1 landed: the band reads by its edges at 1x on both grounds, and the fill stays inside the approved Stone steps (DR-236).
judgments.avoid_bars: The avoid pairs now break "Form to avoid / Do not publish" and "Use instead / Bars" onto two even lines over equal halves. That is a deliberate label, not a wrap, and it holds at 1440 and 390 px.
judgments.charcoal_sketches: On a stage set to Charcoal the avoid bar loses its fill and the "Use instead" box its outline. The guide sets every plate stage on Newsprint in both themes, so no reader meets this; noted only for any later export of a sketch on Charcoal.

weight_recommendation.verdict: Holds. The fix pass spent about 16.8 KB of chapter 14 and lowered the share from 15,872 to 14,600 bytes for each of the 36 plates to come. Round 2’s specimen entries sat at a median of about 11.6 KB in the first build, so rounds 3 and 4 keep room if each plate draws only the rows it shows; map geometry stays held apart.

risks_for_dustin: The red point is now rare in chapter 14’s specimens. After D3-890 none of round 2’s 28 specs draws it, and among the 64 kit specs only S20, S21 and S23 do, all from round 1; readers meet it mostly on Rules 14.3, 14.6 and 14.12. I recommend rounds 3 and 4 choose at least two reader questions on public data where one point, bar or line carries no party tie, so the house’s one red is taught by example as well as by rule.

S01 and S61 still draw the same Senate vote on H.R. 7008. The data lead kept S61’s data (RF-13, no frozen file answers entry 14.87 as well), and the entry now says it draws S01’s vote a second way. Board 2 shows both.
